title: What to buy
sub: All the electronics and hardware for the remote (one collar: the controls on a face curved round the bar, the joystick on its own platform, the electronics in a slim capsule underneath), besides the printed parts. Exact items in COMPONENTS.md.

groups.label: The controls (in the collar's curved face)
groups.note: Buy the items marked "model fits this", then measure them: they have no published drawings.

items.name: 5-way navigation switch, 10 x 10 mm, about 7 mm tall
items.for: The joystick. Easiest: buy the 5-way navigation button module and take its switch off

items.name: Tactile switches, 6 x 6 x 6 mm (round actuator, through-hole)
items.for: The 4 buttons (the height matters: each actuator reaches just up into its dome)

items.name: 30 AWG wire-wrap wire
items.for: The switches' 10 wires: soldered to their legs under the printed carriers, then through the ring's groove to the bay

groups.label: The electronics (in the capsule under the bar)

items.name: ESP32-C3 Super Mini
items.for: Bluetooth (keyboard and media keys) and the dash bus

items.name: SN65HVD230 CAN transceiver chip (SOIC-8, SN65HVD230DR)
items.for: The dash bus: on a SOIC-8 adapter, stuck to the ESP32's back (the smallest bay)

items.name: SOIC-8 to DIP adapter board (about 10 x 12 mm)
items.for: Carries the transceiver chip (no header pins: wires straight to the pads)

items.name: 100 nF ceramic capacitor
items.for: The transceiver's supply, right at the chip

items.name: Or: SN65HVD230 CAN transceiver module
items.for: Instead of the chip (can_board = "module"; the capsule grows). Remove its 120 Ω resistor. The dash's 3-pack has a spare

items.name: 4-core cable (shielded is better), 1–1.5 m
items.for: To the dash's expansion slot (or a USB socket)

items.name: GX12 6-pin aviation plug
items.for: Plugs into one of the dash's expansion slots

items.name: USB-A plug, or an old USB cable to cut
items.for: Without the dash: 5 V from the bike's USB socket

items.name: Foam tape, heat shrink
items.for: The transceiver on the ESP32's back; the boards in the capsule; wiring

items.name: M2.5 heat-set insert (3.6 mm hole, 4 mm) + M2.5 x 8 socket cap screw
items.for: The front screw that closes the collar (from underneath)

items.name: 2 mm steel pin, 19 mm long (or an M2 x 20 screw)
items.for: The hinge at the back of the collar

items.name: 1 mm self-adhesive rubber strip
items.for: Inside both halves of the ring (in the top half it also holds the switch carriers in)

items.name: Clear silicone
items.for: Sealing the wire slot into the capsule

items.name: Printing: about 22 g of ASA or PETG + 3 g of TPU (keypad, the capsule's plug)
items.for: Upload the STLs for an exact quote

note: All prices here are estimates (not checked on listings).
